title: Kauro R2 contract registry
description: Generated from the vendored authority registry (Kauro authority edition R2 (KAVO_REINICIO_20260913, restored 2026-09-13), registry directory authority_r2/registry as installed read-only at /srv/kavo/authority/reinicio/authority_r2/registry on the owner's host; packet manifest PACKET_MANIFEST_SHA256.json sha256 prefix e806ef4e7339fa7a); the R2 text references these definitions as urn:kavo:r2:contracts#/$defs/<Name>.

TenantScope.description: The server derives agency membership and client/project ownership; callers cannot self-assert access. (owner manual 08)

agencyId.description: Owning agency, checked against membership and persisted foreign keys.

clientId.description: End-client workspace where applicable; absence never means cross-client access.

projectId.description: Project scope when the operation is project-bound.

SourceLocator.description: A locator identifies an occurrence, not merely equal content. (owner manual 03)

revisionId.description: Sealed revision that fixes raw bytes and parser choices.

fileId.description: Accepted file entry, not its display name.

logicalRow.description: Zero-based logical data-record ordinal excluding header.

projectionId.description: Declared object projection within the physical row.

FileManifest.description: Only provider-observed bytes and generations may be admitted. (owner manual 09)

storageRef.description: Private registry reference, never a public bucket URI.

providerGeneration.description: Exact immutable generation observed after upload.

sha256.description: Hash recomputed over the complete object bytes.

bytes.description: Observed byte length within the applicable envelope.

scanState.description: Coverage is separate from malware absence.

parserProfileHash.description: Pinned encoding, dialect, workbook and parser configuration.

admitted.description: Derived server decision; a browser cannot set this value.

DatasetRevision.description: Sealing is immutable; replacement creates lineage and invalidates dependent authority. (owner manual 07)

manifestHash.description: Digest of sealed manifest under the declared canonical profile.

supersedesRevisionId.description: Explicit predecessor, never an in-place overwrite.

SourceField.description: Labels are untrusted text and positional identity prevents duplicate-header overwrite. (owner manual 03)

fieldId.description: Stable positional field identity within a table.

label.description: Original decoded header, escaped in UI and classified before model use.

observedType.description: Measurement classification, not permission to coerce.

privacy.description: Classification from actual content and meaning.

profileHash.description: Binding to the full measured profile.

RowCounts.description: Counters have named denominators and cannot be substituted for one another. (owner manual 03)

physicalSourceRows.description: Admitted data occurrences before object projection.

logicalSourceRecords.description: Source object occurrences after explicit projection.

billableSourceUnits.description: Units selected by the pricing definition, frozen before capture.

associationEdges.description: Relationship candidates admitted within the edge envelope.

emittedRepresentatives.description: Terminal source representatives represented in output.

mergedNonSurvivors.description: Source occurrences accounted for by a selected survivor.

rejected.description: Terminal rejected source units with reasons.

withheld.description: Explicitly withheld source units with disposition.

unresolved.description: Nonterminal decisions; positive value blocks final acceptance.

emittedArtifactRows.description: Actual output lines excluding headers; not a conservation proxy.

FieldProfile.description: A sample can describe a sample only; exact claims require complete measured scope. (owner manual 04)

nullCount.description: Typed null or absent count according to parser policy.

emptyStringCount.description: Exact decoded empty strings, separately counted.

distinctCount.description: Exact distinct count only if exact=true.

exact.description: Whether the claimed measure covers the complete scope.

issues.description: Stable issue codes; raw cells remain in authorized evidence storage.

UniquenessProof.description: Uniqueness is scoped by provider, instance, object, field and null/case semantics. (owner manual 03)

completeScope.description: True only for the required full scope.

evidenceHash.description: Verifiable underlying measurement or authoritative metadata.

observedAt.description: Time of observation, checked for future/staleness.

operation.description: Operation for which this proof is admissible.

TargetField.description: Actual API names, writability, types and constraints control output. (owner manual 05)

apiName.description: Exact field API name, not translated display label.

createable.description: Actual create capability. Null is explicitly unknown and cannot authorize the operation.

updateable.description: Actual update capability. Null is explicitly unknown and cannot authorize the operation.

requiredOnCreate.description: Observed create requirement, including object profile rules. Null is explicitly unknown and cannot authorize the operation.

maxLength.description: Character or byte unit is specified in the owning importer profile.

allowedValues.description: Complete allowed option API values when relevant; labels may be sensitive.

clearMechanism.description: Qualified mechanism; blank is not assumed clear.

unique.description: Metadata claim still requires correct scope and semantics.

nillable.description: Whether the actual target permits null; null means unknown.

constraintStatus.description: Evidence status of the field constraints; does not grant authority by itself.

allowedValuesStatus.description: An empty list with UNKNOWN is not an unconstrained enum.

constraintEvidenceHash.description: Verified field-specific metadata and dependent/record-type constraint evidence.

TargetObject.description: Only declared object operations and fields may be compiled. (owner manual 05)

operations.description: Qualified CREATE, UPDATE and/or UPSERT operations.

identifierFields.description: Eligible identity API fields, each with its own proof.

relationships.description: Qualified relationship API names, not arbitrary dotted paths.

mode.description: Public mode; legacy adapter mapping is explicit.

bodyHash.description: Digest of the immutable target-body preimage defined in HASHING_AND_ACCOUNTING_RULES; confirmation and attestation envelope are verified separately.

confirmedAt.description: Agency confirmation of this exact version.

capabilityVersion.description: Version of the supported capability matrix.

ValueIntent.description: SET requires an exact value; CLEAR requires an authority binding; other kinds cannot smuggle values. (owner manual 03)

value.description: Exact typed value for SET only; large numeric values use decimal strings.

authorityHash.description: Scoped agency-decision/effect evidence hash, not the final PlanApproval hash; prevents circular plan authority.

reasonCode.description: Stable reason with evidence in the decision record.

DecisionEvidence.description: A rationale cannot invent its own facts; every decision names verifiable inputs. (owner manual 06)

provenance.description: Decision origin, not authority level by itself.

factHashes.description: Profile, target, agency or compatible memory facts actually checked.

comparisonHash.description: Recorded comparison over the referenced facts.

actorId.description: Required for agency decisions; opaque authorized identity.

FieldMapping.description: Same target field in distinct source-object scopes is not automatically a conflict. (owner manual 06)

IdentityDecision.description: Similarity does not grant merge or update identity. (owner manual 03)

proof.description: Scoped proof required where the strategy relies on it.

fieldConflictPolicyHash.description: Per-field conflict resolution, including consent restrictions.

approvalHash.description: Scoped agency-decision/effect evidence hash, not the final PlanApproval hash; prevents circular plan authority.

TransformStep.description: Parameters use a primitive-specific closed schema, not arbitrary executable code. (owner manual 04)

primitive.description: Member of the qualified primitive catalogue.

dependsOn.description: Predecessor steps in an acyclic graph.

RelationshipDecision.description: Every endpoint is scoped and every edge gets a disposition. (owner manual 03)

requiredStageId.description: Parent stage whose receipt supplies new IDs.

approvalHash.description: Scoped agency-decision/effect evidence hash, not the final PlanApproval hash; prevents circular plan authority.

Plan.description: A plan revision is immutable after validation/approval and cannot execute from a stale binding. (owner manual 07)

bodyHash.description: Digest of immutable plan semantics; lifecycle state/version envelope and final approval are excluded by the named preimage.

Approval.description: Approval is a signed-off subject, not a mutable boolean. (owner manual 07)

disclosuresHash.description: UI-disclosed effects, counts, risks and limitations.

ValidationReceipt.description: All bindings and evidence digests are required, internally consistent and independently checked. (owner manual 04)

artifactEvidenceHash.description: Output/preview validation evidence for this phase.

completedAt.description: Completion, not before start or in the future.

result.description: Explicit result; no truthy success coercion.

ModelTask.description: The candidate set and policy are part of idempotency identity. (owner manual 06)

minimizedRequestHash.description: Hash of complete final serialized outbound content.

interpretationDeadline.description: No new semantic calls after this deadline.

RequestJournal.description: Persist response before marking consumed; ambiguity is an explicit state. (owner manual 06)

requestHash.description: Exact final request bytes or canonical transport representation.

responseArtifactHash.description: Required once a complete response is durable.

actualCents.description: Known billed/estimated usage under explicit status.

Lease.description: An old live worker cannot publish after another owner advances the fence. (owner manual 07)

cancelVersion.description: Cancellation generation observed by the worker.

Quote.description: Price validity is separate from source availability; terms are immutable once issued. (owner manual 16)

discountCents.description: Applied maximum eligible promotion, not stacked.

termsHash.description: Accepted scope, refund, retention and contract terms.

PaymentOrder.description: Local intent precedes provider effect; order identity cannot migrate between tenants. (owner manual 15)

idempotencyHash.description: Intent binding; same key different payload conflicts.

CaptureFact.description: Browser claims cannot produce a capture fact. (owner manual 15)

merchantRef.description: Observed payee matched to expected merchant.

environment.description: Must match the order and production gate.

status.description: Provider state mapped without optimistic coercion.

evidenceHash.description: Authenticated event/query evidence, minimized for retention.

Refund.description: A refund is a reconciled effect, not merely a submitted request. (owner manual 15)

authorizationHash.description: Required approval or standing authorized policy reference.

Settlement.description: Captured, held, withdrawn and bank-available funds are distinct. (owner manual 15)

withdrawnCents.description: Funds sent to bank, not automatically credited.

bankAvailableCents.description: Actually available amount under observed statement.

CommercialAuthorization.description: Every prerequisite binds the same source and policy; server creates this record. (owner manual 07)

revokedAt.description: Prevents future execution/finalization as defined by state.

Job.description: One logical job may have attempts; only a fenced accepted attempt publishes. (owner manual 07)

providerJobId.description: Actual Batch or equivalent execution identity.

inputBindingHash.description: Source, plan, target, core and policy bundle.

packageId.description: Accepted output, present only after verified publication.

ImportStage.description: A stage is a preparation step, not proof the customer imported successfully. (owner manual 05)

StageReceipt.description: Receipt scope, membership, target IDs and completeness must be proved. (owner manual 05)

stageId.description: Exact stage that produced the imported records.

unresolvedRows.description: Missing/ambiguous mappings, which block dependent edges.

Artifact.description: Artifact role, bytes, identity and privacy determine its use. (owner manual 13)

relativePath.description: Portable normalized path with traversal/absolute/control characters rejected.

recordCount.description: Declared data records excluding headers where relevant.

objectApiName.description: Exact target object for import files.

PackageManifest.description: Hashes alone do not prove conservation or permitted target effects. (owner manual 13)

createdAt.description: Creation metadata excluded from deterministic content where specified.

DeletionRequest.description: Delete authority revokes new work before cleanup and survives backup restore. (owner manual 09)

residualClasses.description: Lawful financial/security or provider-retained residuals, explicitly named.

Agency.description: An agency may contain many end clients; the seller does not gain CRM access. (owner manual 16)

displayName.description: Safe agency label, not a unique legal identity.

Membership.description: Membership capabilities are assigned by authorized commands, never browser claims. (owner manual 08)

EndClient.description: Client labels are presentation; legal and data boundaries remain explicit. (owner manual 16)

processingAuthorityRef.description: Agency evidence of authority to provide this client's data.

Prospect.description: Prospect data remains limited to lawful commercial context. (owner manual 18)

businessContactRef.description: Restricted contact record, not raw details in reports.

sourceEvidenceHash.description: Where and why the prospect was legitimately collected.

jurisdiction.description: Applicable outreach territory, not guessed from language alone.

suppressed.description: Global no-send control that overrides automation.

AttributionClaim.description: Accepted acquisition rights differ from current account servicing. (owner manual 17)

sellerId.description: Claiming person under an active agreement.

expiresAt.description: Ninety-day initial claim window unless documented qualifying extension applies.

evidenceHash.description: Substantive acquisition evidence, not a scraped list.

SellerAgreement.description: Actual legal classification requires substance-based review before activation. (owner manual 17)

firstBps.description: Initial 1000 basis points unless a prospective signed exception.

CommissionEntitlement.description: Rate and window bind a historical agency acquisition; refunds adjust the basis. (owner manual 17)

shareBps.description: Share of the commission pool, totals exactly 10000 across a split.

CommissionLine.description: Calculate cumulative entitlement in exact minor units and derive adjustments. (owner manual 17)

netServiceBasisCents.description: Service collected after discount and cumulative refunds, excluding tax.

previousPostedCents.description: Prior positive total before explicit adjustments.

eligibleAt.description: Thirty days after final contracted preparation completion plus stated conditions.

CommissionStatement.description: Statements reveal each project and adjustment without exposing customer CRM data. (owner manual 17)

lineIds.description: Complete included commission and adjustment references.

payableCents.description: Actual payable amount after reconciled adjustments.

heldCents.description: Held with specific reason and review date.

payoutEvidenceHash.description: Actual settled payout evidence, not only submission.

balance.description: The statement's balance (F-17). Optional in the stored record, which predates adoption; the statement read computes it for every statement, old ones included, from the statement's own items.

balanceItems.description: Offsets, retainer accruals and reviews (F-16, F-17).

FiscalProfile.description: No default tax rate can substitute for actual fiscal applicability. (owner manual 15)

TaxDocument.description: Provider issuance uncertainty is reconciled by exact identity before retry. (owner manual 15)

LedgerEntry.description: The ledger is append-only; corrections use reversal and new entries. (owner manual 15)

currency.description: ISO currency for this ledger partition.

sourceRef.description: Capture, refund, fee, payout or reviewed adjustment.

SupportCase.description: Support metadata must not become an unrestricted raw-data channel. (owner manual 18)

Incident.description: Containment, restoration and customer communication are separately evidenced. (owner manual 14)

affectedScopes.description: Safe scope identifiers, no raw customer values.

Capability.description: Requested, implemented and qualified are different states. (owner manual 02)

qualificationEvidenceHashes.description: Independent evidence on the accepted candidate.

GateEvidence.description: Evidence names an exact subject, command, result, environment and immutable artifact. (owner manual 21)

exitCode.description: Observed exit, not a summarized success word.

Finding.description: A finding separates expected behavior, observed result and harness limitations. (owner manual 21)

affectedEvidence.description: Evidence to invalidate or retain with reason.

OwnerAction.description: An unmaterialized card is not an instruction to click a guessed UI. (owner manual 24)

destination.description: Verified current URL/screen or actual professional recipient.

requiredInput.description: Minimal private fact or consent, without secrets in this source.

maximumCostCents.description: Concrete ceiling when spending is involved.

agentPreparationHash.description: Evidence the technical work is already prepared.

UploadSession.description: Application acceptance and provider session lifetime are independent. (owner manual 09)

providerSessionSecretRef.description: Private bearer reference; never included in generic DTO/logs.

Audit.description: The logical audit retains its original deadlines and grant across retries. (owner manual 06)

targetContractId.description: Exact target version; absent for CLEAN, whose audit binds the canonical CLEAN target hash.

candidateManifestHash.description: Complete expected candidate set after planning.

CostGrant.description: A monthly funding statement is not a grant of currently available money. (owner manual 06)

reconciledSpendCents.description: Known consumption under the actual tariff.

availableCents.description: Derived remaining amount; never browser-provided authority.

priceProfileHash.description: Exact dated rates and conservative overhead.

Candidate.description: Coverage and permissible choices are fixed before provider response evaluation. (owner manual 06)

alternativeIds.description: Closed allowed alternatives including explicit abstention where appropriate.

MemoryDecision.description: Memory is evidence with scope and expiry, never automatic authority. (owner manual 06)

PrimitiveDefinition.description: A primitive is executable only within its typed input/output/effect contract. (owner manual 04)

requiresAgencyAuthority.description: Necessary but not sufficient approval condition.

PaymentAttempt.description: Network failure alone cannot establish no external effect. (owner manual 15)

PriceEligibilitySnapshot.description: A price snapshot cannot change after capture because later history changes. (owner manual 16)

qualifyingProjectIds.description: Complete prior distinct paid/non-fully-refunded project set.

qualifyingCount.description: Must equal that unique set size.

RetentionRecord.description: The effective deadline is a minimum of named anchors; retries do not extend it. (owner manual 09)

softDeadline.description: Policy interval from the applicable ready event.

hardDeadline.description: Absolute maximum from the owning immutable event; only the one extension of an UNPAID record may move it, to at most the policy's UNPAID ceiling from sealing.

effectiveDeadline.description: Minimum active deadline after all relevant caps.

providerResiduals.description: Observed classes that outlive active access with reasons.

DomainEvent.description: Payload is allowlisted references and safe counts, never raw CRM rows. (owner manual 07)

OutboxRecord.description: Outbox delivery is not the business effect itself. (owner manual 07)

InboxRecord.description: Environment and provider identity participate in deduplication. (owner manual 07)

QualificationRun.description: Run identity must represent a separate actual invocation on the same candidate. (owner manual 21)

status.description: No incomplete run counted as qualification.

ModelProfile.description: A model name alone is not an eligible transport or production winner. (owner manual 06)

endpointProfileHash.description: Request shape and audience binding without credentials.

ReportSnapshot.description: Presentation cannot invent facts or expose raw data beyond the chosen report class. (owner manual 13)

ReleaseCandidate.description: A changed dependency or image produces a different candidate even with identical source text. (owner manual 21)

imageDigests.description: Exact OCI content digests without display aliases.

CommissionAdjustment.description: An adjustment records a difference without editing historical paid lines. (owner manual 17)

amountCents.description: Exact difference from prior cumulative entitlement.

sourceEventId.description: Reconciled financial or reviewed correction event.

OutreachDraft.description: Editing a draft cannot send it or imply recipient permission. (owner manual 18)

contentRef.description: Private draft content reference; never raw customer CRM.

OutreachAuthorization.description: Permission is specific to recipients, content, sender, purpose, time and count. (owner manual 18)

maximumSends.description: Bounded positive maximum, also no greater than sealed unique drafts.

policyVersion.description: Applicable provider, suppression and contact policy.

revoked.description: Current server-observed revocation, checked at dispatch.

SalesActivity.description: Observed submission, receipt and customer response are different facts. (owner manual 18)

occurredAt.description: Observed event time; unknown time cannot be fabricated.

providerMessageRef.description: Opaque external identity or explicit NONE for a local suppression.

ProjectDate.description: One date of one kind with its own rule; a date is never derived by adding another kind's period, and an estimate is never shown as a commitment. (owner manual 09)

kind.description: Which of the five dates (F-24); PENDING_PAYMENT_HOLD is reserved (the item's reservation) and NOT_APPLICABLE until CP-02.17 is active.

state.description: NOT_APPLICABLE: no anchor yet or not offered; AVAILABLE: may be requested (extension); RUNNING; ENDED; USED: the one extension was granted.

at.description: The date itself, when the anchor exists.

hardLimit.description: Retention kinds only: the absolute maximum the record allows (14 days from sealing, 17 with the UNPAID extension under CP-01.02).

rule.description: The policy key that sets the date, e.g. pricing.quoteDays or retention.unpaidDaysFromReady.

policyVersion.description: The version the date was computed under: pricing.scheduleVersion or the record's retention label.

anchor.description: The fact the date counts from.

sourceId.description: The quote, retention record, extension or hold the date is read from.

actionAvailable.description: What may be done about this date now; RECORD_TRANSFER_PROOF only after CP-02.17.

actionRole.description: Who may do it (the command's registry role; Order 15 enforces it).

ProjectDates.description: Exactly one entry per kind, in the order of the kind enum; the governing retention kind names which date deletes the data, it never adds two dates. (owner manual 09)

dates.description: The five dates, one per kind.

governingRetentionKind.description: The retention date that currently governs deletion (the later of extension and hold, never their sum).

ProjectSummary.description: The stage is derived from durable facts at read time; it is a label for navigation, never authority for a command. (owner manual 11)

name.description: The project's purpose as its name (CMD011 purpose).

stage.description: Current stage (for CLEAN, IMPORT never appears).

waitingOn.description: Who the next step waits for.

needsAction.description: A blocker or a date within the alert window exists.

ProjectStageCount.description: Counts only the caller's agency. (owner manual 11)

BoardSummary.description: Counts are of the caller's agency at one database instant. (owner manual 11)

ClientSummary.description: A client label is presentation; legal and data boundaries stay those of EndClient. (owner manual 11)

FindingExampleRef.description: A reference, never a value: the cell is read through PreviewTable under its own authorization and the plan's privacy class. (owner manual 06)

AuditFindingSummary.description: Counts and references only; no cell value, and no more examples than the plan's privacy class allows. (owner manual 06)

findingCode.description: The core's finding token; the web maps it to its copy (consequence and fix).

fixAvailable.description: The plan can carry a fix.

PriceEstimate.description: An estimate, never a quote or a reservation: no discount, tax, founding slot or terms; the quote (CMD027) decides the price. (owner manual 15)

policyBaseServiceCents.description: Base price of the band in the current schedule (baseCentsOf).

ActivityEntry.description: Built from committed events of the caller's agency only; payload references, never labels or rows. (owner manual 11)

actorKind.description: Who acted; a Kauro person is never named.

actorMembershipId.description: The member, when an agency member acted.

BillingProfileSummary.description: Reads what CMD002 and CMD027 require; no tax rate is inferred. (owner manual 15)

paidProjectCount.description: Projects with a captured payment in pricing.repeatLookbackDays (the repeat-discount count).

BillingDocumentItem.description: A captured payment is the only 'paid'; an issued tax document is never shown as money received. (owner manual 15)

fiscalDocumentNumber.description: Issued tax document number, if any.

PackageArtifactItem.description: Customer-facing artifacts only: the vocabulary has no EVIDENCE role and no INTERNAL_EVIDENCE privacy, so internal evidence cannot be listed. (owner manual 13)

PackageSummary.description: Lists customer-facing artifacts only (PackageArtifactItem has no internal evidence). (owner manual 13)

DeletionRecordItem.description: A receipt of what was deleted and what stays outside the managed scope; never the tombstone itself. (owner manual 09)

RefundListItem.description: A refund is a reconciled effect; REQUESTED or APPROVED is never shown as money returned. (owner manual 15)

RetentionExtension.description: One per project across every retention class; it never revives expired data, and only an UNPAID record's extension may move its hard deadline, to at most the policy's UNPAID ceiling from sealing. (owner manual 09)

hardDeadline.description: Hard deadline after (moves for UNPAID only).

ceilingDeadline.description: The most the extension could reach: the hard deadline for paid classes, sealing plus retention.extendHardCapExceptions.UNPAID.ceilingDaysFromSeal for UNPAID.

ConsentRecord.description: One record per act, kind and channel; never pre-ticked or bundled; a session, a login or a step-up is never a consent; withdrawal is a new state of the same record, never an edit of its proof. (owner manual 08)

kind.description: What was authorized; MARKETING_COMMUNICATIONS is separate and optional (POL 8.3).

channel.description: Marketing channel; NOT_APPLICABLE for the other kinds.

documentHash.description: SHA-256 of the exact text presented.

evidenceHash.description: Hash of the evidence bundle (presented text hash, unticked-by-default control state, user, time).

ConsentView.description: What the person gave and when; the server's evidence hash stays out. (owner manual 08)

NotificationPreference.description: An ESSENTIAL topic is always enabled; marketing is not a topic (it is a ConsentRecord). (owner manual 11)

NotificationPreferenceChoice.description: Names an OPTIONAL topic; an ESSENTIAL one is refused. (owner manual 11)

NotificationPreferences.description: Every topic appears once; essential ones enabled. (owner manual 11)

ClaimReview.description: At most one open review per claim decision; a review never changes a claim by itself. (owner manual 17)

state.description: UPHELD and CHANGED are set by DecideClaimReview (CP-02.14).

SellerClaimView.description: The seller reads the neutral message only (OPS-2); never the internal reason, evidence, note or another seller's claim. (owner manual 17)

organizationLabel.description: Prospect organization as the seller registered it.

expiresAt.description: End of the claim (the 14- and 3-day alerts count to it).

sellerMessage.description: The neutral message of a refusal or of 'Not available to claim'.

reviewAvailable.description: A review may be requested now.

ClaimDecisionEntry.description: Append-only, in commit order; the owner sees reason, evidence and note. (owner manual 17)

reasonCode.description: Refusal or decision code (closed list after CP-01.04).

note.description: The owner's note or the seller's review note.

SellerClaimDecisionEntry.description: The seller's projection of ClaimDecisionEntry: no reason, evidence or note. (owner manual 17)

SellerListItem.description: Owner only; rates and retainer are the agreement in force; money figures are CP-02.09's. (owner manual 17)

CustomerListItem.description: Net revenue is collections net of refunds without tax, never invoices; one capture counts once. (owner manual 17)

netRevenueCents.description: Collections net of completed refunds, tax excluded, all time.

StatementPeriodItem.description: One row per issued statement version; amounts are the statement's. (owner manual 17)

SellerWonCustomer.description: Only the seller's own converted claims; dates, never amounts of the customer. (owner manual 17)

finalCompletionAt.description: Final completion of the first project.

commissionEligibleOn.description: Eligibility date (30 days after final completion).

SellerSchedule.description: The seller's own records; dates from commission.statementBusinessDay and payBusinessDay. (owner manual 17)

SellerMoneySummary.description: Collections, never invoices: a collection counts in the month its capture was confirmed and a refund in the month it happened, never rewriting an earlier period; tax excluded; one capture counted once and split shares applied once; earned, held, payable and paid kept apart; pending = held + payable as of computedAt. (owner manual 17)

sellerId.description: Seller; absent on the total row.

netAttributableRevenueCents.description: What attributed customers paid for the service, collections confirmed in the period net of refunds that happened in the period, tax excluded; never Kauro's revenue.

commissionGeneratedCents.description: Commission earned on that revenue in the period, after offsets.

commissionPendingCents.description: Earned not yet paid, as of computedAt: held plus payable.

StatementBalance.description: payable = earned − offsets + retainer − held, in exact minor units; each figure is a sum of the statement's own items. (owner manual 17)

offsetCents.description: Offsets applied under the agreement in force.

retainerCents.description: Retainer accrued for the period (0 unless a signed agreement sets one).

StatementBalanceItem.description: An offset names its refund, the adjusted line and the clause; a retainer names its month; nothing is applied without the agreement in force. (owner manual 17)

lineId.description: The statement line: the commission line, the adjustment or the retainer accrual.

clauseRef.description: OFFSET: the agreement clause or rule applied.

accrualMonthStart.description: RETAINER: first instant of the accrued month.

AlertCondition.description: A condition of the same subject; it never produces a second alert. (owner manual 17)

conditionCode.description: What triggers it, e.g. FILE_DELETION, QUOTE_EXPIRY, PAYMENT_DUE, CLAIM_END, PILOT_REVIEW.

Alert.description: Each subject appears once, under its most urgent kind (alerts.precedence); its other conditions are its second line. (owner manual 17)

alertKey.description: Deterministic key of subject and kind (de-duplicates sends).

lastMaterialProgressAt.description: INACTIVE: the latest act of alerts.relevantProgress.counts.

policyVersion.description: Edition of the alerts policy applied.

SellerAlertView.description: Only the seller's own claims; no project, agency or pilot alert. (owner manual 17)

kind.description: Claim end passed or within the alert days.

policyVersion.description: Edition of the alerts policy applied.

PolicyLegalStatus.description: Approving a rule does not validate it legally; the state says so until counsel's validation is recorded. (owner manual 17)

StatementCsvRow.description: RFC 4180, UTF-8, one header row; a cell starting with =, +, -, @, tab or carriage return is prefixed with an apostrophe; amounts are minor units; no customer CRM data. (owner manual 17)

OutreachAuthorizationRequest.description: A request is neither an authorization nor the recipient's consent; only AuthorizeOutreach (CMD062) grants, bound to content hashes. (owner manual 17)

state.description: GRANTED when an authorization covering contentHash is committed.

SellerOutreachRequestView.description: The seller reads the state of their own request; never the owner's decline code or note. (owner manual 17)

ClaimRefusal.description: The code is one of commission.claimRefusalReasons of listVersion; evidence on every refusal; OTHER needs a note; OWNER_RULE names a versioned rule in force when the claimed facts happened, never a later one; the seller message derives from the code, never from the note. (owner manual 17)

ownerRuleRef.description: OWNER_RULE: the rule id and version in force at the decision.

IdentityGroupView.description: PROVEN_IDENTITY only from Migration Core's proving keys without a blocking conflict; same normalized e-mail and full name is a CANDIDATE, never proof; nothing is folded to manufacture a proof; a CANDIDATE is unified only by a person. (owner manual 06)

provingKey.description: The proving key, for PROVEN_IDENTITY; NONE otherwise.

candidateSignals.description: Signals of a candidate, e.g. SAME_NORMALIZED_EMAIL, SAME_NORMALIZED_FULL_NAME.

PlanDecisionPreview.description: The apply or the decision binds previewHash; any change in the groups makes it stale. (owner manual 06)

IdentityDecisionRecord.description: Records decision, evidence, responsible person, version and effect (identityResolution.decisionRecord); append-only. (owner manual 06)

evidenceHash.description: Hash of the evidence the decision saw.

responsibleMembershipId.description: The person (PERSON), or the member who applied the proven rule.

effect.description: Effect in the plan (Kauro never writes to a CRM).
